加 -ation 构成，义为「召唤到旁；辩护」，今较罕见

senses.title: A person who publicly supports a cause
senses.definition: a person who argues in favour of a policy, idea or group, often repeatedly and in public
senses.definitionCN: 为某项政策、理念或群体辩护的人，常反复且公开地表态
senses.example: She is an outspoken advocator of prison reform.
senses.exampleCN: 她是监狱改革直言不讳的提倡者。
senses.why: Advocare means to call someone to your side, so an advocator is the voice you have summoned to speak for a cause.
senses.whyCN: advocare 意为「把某人叫到身边」，所以 advocator 就是你为一项事业召来的那个声音——他替你开口。

senses.title: A pleader in Scots law
senses.definition: in Scots law, a lawyer admitted to plead before the higher courts, a member of the Faculty of Advocates
senses.definitionCN: 在苏格兰法中，获准在高等法院出庭辩护的律师，即律师公会成员
senses.example: The advocator addressed the court on a point of procedure.
senses.exampleCN: 那位辩护人就一项程序问题向法庭陈述。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense and the closest to the Latin: the advocatus was literally the friend called into court to stand beside the accused.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，也最贴近拉丁语：advocatus 字面上就是被叫进法庭、站在被告身旁的朋友。

intro.en: Advocator comes from calling, not from seeing: Latin vocare, to call, is the engine of the whole family.
intro.cn: advocator 来自「叫」，不是「看」：拉丁语 vocare「呼叫」是整个词族的引擎。

items.en: Vocare meant to call, and it also gave English voice, vocal, vocabulary and invoke.
items.cn: vocare 意为「呼叫」，它也给了英语 voice、vocal、vocabulary 与 invoke。

items.en: Advocare joined ad-, to, with vocare, meaning to call someone to one’s aid, especially in court.
items.cn: advocare 把 ad-「向」与 vocare 结合，义为「召人来相助」，尤指法庭上。

items.en: Advocatus was the person so called: a legal helper or friend who stood beside a party in a suit.
items.cn: advocatus 就是被召来的人：在诉讼中站在当事人身旁的法律帮手或朋友。

items.en: Old French avocat carried the legal sense into medieval Europe and later into English advocate.
items.cn: 古法语 avocat 把法律义带入中世纪欧洲，后来进入英语 advocate。

items.en: Advocator is advocate plus the agent suffix -or; it survives mainly in Scots law and in formal prose, while advocate is the everyday noun.
items.cn: advocator 由 advocate 加施事后缀 -or 构成；它主要存留于苏格兰法与正式文体，日常名词用 advocate。

note.en: The look-alike group warns about avocation, which looks related but means a hobby; the near-meaning group lists other public supporters.
note.cn: 形近组提醒 avocation 看似同族却指「爱好」；近义组列出其他公开支持者。

entries.definition: The everyday noun and verb for a public supporter.
entries.definitionCN: 表示公开支持者的常用名词与动词。

entries.definition: The activity of arguing for a cause.
entries.definitionCN: 为某项事业辩护的活动。

entries.definition: A hobby, from a- meaning away plus vocare, so calling away from work.
entries.definitionCN: 爱好，源自 a-「离开」加 vocare，即把工作叫开。

entries.definition: A person who argues in favour of a proposal.
entries.definitionCN: 为某项提议辩护的人。

entries.definition: A person who fights or argues for a cause.
entries.definitionCN: 为某项事业奋战或辩护的人。

entries.definition: A person who approves of and backs a person or idea.
entries.definitionCN: 赞同并支持某人或某理念的人。

normalIntro.en: Hear the call inside advocator: voc is the same voc as voice and vocal.
normalIntro.cn: 听出 advocator 里的「叫」：voc 与 voice、vocal 中的 voc 相同。

normal.en: Ad plus voc plus -ator: the one called to your side to speak.
normal.cn: ad 加 voc 加 -ator：被叫到你身边替你说话的人。

normal.en: Vocare means to call, so advocator is a caller-for, not a looker-on.
normal.cn: vocare 意为「呼叫」，所以 advocator 是替人喊话的人，不是旁观者。

normal.en: Advocator and advocate share a stem; the -or ending only makes it sound more formal.
normal.cn: advocator 与 advocate 同干；-or 结尾只是让它听起来更正式。

normal.en: Do not confuse advocacy with avocation: one is arguing for a cause, the other is a hobby.
normal.cn: 别把 advocacy 与 avocation 弄混：前者为事业辩护，后者是爱好。

normal.en: In court the advocator stands beside you, which is exactly what ad- plus vocare describes.
normal.cn: 法庭上 advocator 站在你身旁，这正是 ad- 加 vocare 描述的画面。

abstract.en: Picture a silent defendant and a friend summoned to speak in his place.
abstract.cn: 想象一个沉默的被告，和一位被召来替他说话的朋友。

abstract.en: Imagine a cause with no voice until someone is called to lend it one.
abstract.cn: 想象一项事业本无声，直到有人被召来借给它一个声音。

abstract.en: Think of a megaphone handed to the person who believes in the idea most.
abstract.cn: 想象把扩音器递给最相信这个理念的人。

examples.en: He was remembered as an advocator of universal education.
examples.cn: 人们记得他是普及教育的提倡者。

examples.en: The advocator rose and addressed the bench without notes.
examples.cn: 辩护人起身，不用讲稿向法官席陈述。

examples.en: Few advocators of the policy remained after the scandal.
examples.cn: 丑闻之后，这项政策的拥护者所剩无几。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「爱的我凯特」——爱（ad）我（vo）凯（ca）特（tor），爱我的人被叫来替我说话，就是提倡者、辩护人。

root: 拉丁语 ad-「向」加 vocare「呼叫」构成 advocare「召来相助」，其过去分词 advocatus 指「被召到身旁的人」，经古法语 avocat 进入英语，加 -or 成 advocator。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses keep the image of a voice summoned to stand beside someone: for a cause in public, or for a client in court.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都保留「被召来站在某人身旁的声音」这一意象：在公开场合为事业，或在法庭上为当事人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a voice called to stand beside you
core.cn: 核心意象：被叫来站在你身旁的声音

branches.en: The voice speaks for an idea.
branches.cn: 这个声音为理念说话。

branches.en: The voice speaks for a client in court.
branches.cn: 这个声音在法庭上为当事人说话。

branches.en: Both are summoned rather than self-appointed.
branches.cn: 两者都是被召来，而非自封。

branches.en: Support repeated in public over years.
branches.cn: 多年在公开场合反复支持。

branches.en: Support formalized as a legal qualification.
branches.cn: 支持被制度化为一种法律资格。

intro.en: The family is built on vocare, to call, so every relative keeps the idea of a voice being summoned.
intro.cn: 这个词族建立在 vocare「呼叫」上，所以每个亲属词都保留「声音被召来」的想法。

latinIntro.en: Latin ad- plus vocare gave advocare and advocatus; English borrowed the stem twice, as advocate and as advocator.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ad- 加 vocare 产生 advocare 与 advocatus；英语两次借用这个词干，成为 advocate 与 advocator。

latinEntries.example: Vocare is the root of advocate.
latinEntries.exampleCN: vocare 是 advocate 的词根。

latinEntries.example: Advocare was used of legal help.

definition_zh: 风向；风吹来的方位；风向观测；风向切变；舆论走向（比喻义）
definition_en: the compass direction from which the wind blows
core_image: 机场草地上一只橙白条纹的风向袋被风撑满，袋口指向与风来向相反的一侧
scene: 机场草地上，一只橙白相间的风向袋被风吹得笔直，地勤说 The wind direction decides which runway the aircraft will use.
sceneCN: 这里 wind direction 指「风从哪个方位吹来」（第 6 个义项：航空作业中依据风向选择跑道）；句意为风向决定飞机使用哪条跑道。图中可辨识物件：风向袋、跑道、飞机、地勤人员。

pos.zh: 风向；风吹来的方位（可数，复数 wind directions）

senses.title: The direction the wind comes from
senses.definition: the point of the compass from which the air is moving toward the observer
senses.definitionCN: 空气朝观察者移动时所来自的罗盘方位
senses.example: A northerly wind direction brought cold air down from the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 偏北的风向把冷空气从山上带下来。
senses.why: Meteorology names wind by where it comes from, not where it goes, so direction is always the source side.
senses.whyCN: 气象学按风的来向而非去向命名，因此风向总是指来源一侧。

senses.title: A compass bearing on the rose
senses.titleCN: 罗盘方位上的风向表示
senses.definition: the wind direction expressed as one of the compass points or as a bearing in degrees
senses.definitionCN: 用罗盘方位点或角度表示的风向
senses.example: The log recorded a wind direction of two hundred and seventy degrees.
senses.exampleCN: 日志记录的风向是二百七十度。
senses.why: To be useful, a direction must be fitted to a scale, and the compass rose supplies that scale.
senses.whyCN: 方向要有用，就必须装进一个刻度，而罗盘方位图提供了这个刻度。

senses.title: A standard weather observation
senses.definition: the entry for wind direction in a routine weather report, usually paired with speed
senses.definitionCN: 常规天气报告中关于风向的记录项，通常与风速并列
senses.example: Every station reports wind direction at the top of the hour.
senses.exampleCN: 每个测站都在整点报告风向。
senses.why: Observational practice turns a physical fact into a fixed slot in a report, and the slot keeps the name.
senses.whyCN: 观测惯例把一个物理事实变成报告里的固定栏目，栏目沿用这个名称。

senses.title: Read from a vane or windsock
senses.titleCN: 用风向标或风向袋读出风向
senses.definition: the wind direction shown by an instrument such as a wind vane, a windsock or a sensor
senses.definitionCN: 由风向标、风向袋或传感器显示出的风向
senses.example: The windsock's wind direction told the pilot the breeze was from the left.
senses.exampleCN: 风向袋显示的风向告诉飞行员，微风来自左侧。
senses.why: Instruments exist to make the invisible direction visible, and the reading is simply called the wind direction.
senses.whyCN: 仪器的作用是让看不见的方向变得可见，而读数就直接称为风向。

senses.title: Where pollution will drift
senses.definition: the direction in which smoke, dust or a gas plume will be carried from a source
senses.definitionCN: 烟、尘或气羽从源头被带往的方向
senses.example: The wind direction carried the smoke away from the village.
senses.exampleCN: 风向把烟带离了村庄。
senses.why: Air quality work asks the same question as weather: which way is the air going, and the phrase is reused unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 空气质量工作问的是与天气相同的问题：空气往哪边走，短语原样沿用。

senses.title: A factor in take-off and landing
senses.titleCN: 航空与航海作业中的风向因素
senses.definition: the direction of the wind relative to a runway, deck or course, which determines the safest heading
senses.definitionCN: 风相对于跑道、甲板或航向的方向，它决定最安全的朝向
senses.example: The tower changed the active runway when the wind direction shifted.
senses.exampleCN: 风向改变时，塔台更换了使用中的跑道。
senses.why: Aircraft and ships must meet the wind head-on where possible, so the phrase becomes an operational instruction.
senses.whyCN: 飞机与船只应尽可能迎着风，因此这个短语成了操作指令。

senses.title: Change of direction with height
senses.definition: the turning of the wind from one level to another, a component of wind shear
senses.definitionCN: 风在不同高度之间发生的转向，是风切变的一部分
senses.example: A sudden change in wind direction near the surface warned of a downburst.
senses.exampleCN: 近地面风向的突然改变预示着下击暴流。
senses.why: Comparing direction at two heights turns the phrase into a diagnostic for shear and turbulence.
senses.whyCN: 比较两个高度的风向，使这个短语成为判断切变与颠簸的指标。

senses.title: The way opinion is turning
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：舆论或局势的走向
senses.definition: the general tendency in which public opinion or events are moving
senses.definitionCN: 公众意见或事件正在移动的总趋势
senses.example: The wind direction in the committee changed after the report leaked.
senses.exampleCN: 报告泄露后，委员会里的风向变了。
senses.why: The metaphor treats opinion as weather: it has a direction, and people watch which way it blows.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻把舆论当成天气：它有方向，人们会观察它往哪边吹。

intro.en: Wind direction joins the native noun wind with direction, a borrowing from Latin directio, built on dirigere 'to set straight'. The compound is an English descriptive phrase used in weather writing.
intro.cn: wind direction 把本族名词 wind 与借词 direction 组合起来；direction 来自拉丁 directio，由 dirigere「使成直线、引导」构成。这个复合短语是天气文献中的英语描述性说法。

items.en: Wind meant moving air and belongs to the Germanic stock shared by Dutch wind and German Wind.
items.cn: wind 意为流动的空气，与荷兰语 wind、德语 Wind 同属日耳曼语族。

items.en: Regere meant 'to rule, guide, keep straight', with the past participle rectus; it also gives English rectangle and correct.
items.cn: regere 意为「统治、引导、使保持笔直」，过去分词为 rectus；它还给出英语 rectangle 与 correct。

items.en: Dis- 'apart, in different directions' plus regere produced dirigere 'to set straight, guide, direct'.
items.cn: dis-「分开、朝各方向」加 regere 构成 dirigere「摆直、引导、指挥」。

items.en: The action noun directio 'a setting straight, direction' passed through Old French into English as direction.
items.cn: 动作名词 directio「摆直、指向」经古法语进入英语，成为 direction。

items.en: Wind direction became a routine entry in station records in the nineteenth century; the exact first use of the English phrase is uncertain.
items.cn: 风向在 19 世纪成为测站记录中的常规项目；这个英语短语的确切最早使用不确定。

note.en: Group one holds wind compounds that sit beside wind direction in the same reports; group two holds navigation words that also describe where something points.
note.cn: 第一组是同一批天气报告中与风向并列的风类复合词；第二组是同样描述朝向的航行用词。

entries.definition: The rate at which the air moves, the quantity always reported together with wind direction.
entries.definitionCN: 空气移动的速率，总是与风向一起报告。

entries.definition: A device that turns to show wind direction; it displays the direction rather than being it.
entries.definitionCN: 转动以显示风向的装置；它显示方向，而不是方向本身。

entries.definition: A diagram showing how often the wind blows from each direction at a place.
entries.definitionCN: 显示某地风从各方位吹来频率的图。

entries.definition: A change in wind speed or direction over a short distance; it describes the gradient, not a single bearing.
entries.definitionCN: 风速或风向在短距离内的变化；它描述梯度，而非单一方位。

entries.definition: The angle of a point measured from north; a wind direction can be given as a bearing.
entries.definitionCN: 从北方量起的角度；风向可以用方位角表示。

entries.definition: The direction in which a ship or aircraft is pointing, which may differ from the wind direction.
entries.definitionCN: 船或飞机机头所指的方向，可能与风向不同。

entries.definition: The intended path over the ground, a navigational plan rather than a wind reading.
entries.definitionCN: 计划在地面上走的路径，是航行计划而非风的读数。

entries.definition: The way an object is aligned; it can be chosen, whereas wind direction cannot.
entries.definitionCN: 物体摆放的朝向；它可以被选择，而风向不能。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real native noun, a real Latin root and real weather collocations, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的英语本族名词、真实的拉丁词根与真实天气搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Meteorology names the wind by where it comes from, so wind direction points to the source.
normal.cn: 气象学按来向给风命名，因此风向指向来源。

normal.en: direction comes from dirigere 'to set straight', built on regere 'to guide'.
normal.cn: direction 来自 dirigere「摆直」，其词根是 regere「引导」。

normal.en: Reports always pair wind direction with wind speed.
normal.cn: 天气报告总把风向与风速并列。

normal.en: The instruments have their own names: wind vane, windsock, wind direction sensor.
normal.cn: 仪器各有专名：风向标、风向袋、风向传感器。

normal.en: The same word serves aviation, sailing and air-quality work without changing shape.
normal.cn: 同一个词服务航空、航海与空气质量工作，形态不变。

abstract.en: Picture a striped sock standing straight out, showing exactly where the air was born.
abstract.cn: 想象一只条纹风向袋笔直伸出，指出空气究竟从哪里来。

abstract.en: Picture smoke leaving a chimney and bending away from the houses.
abstract.cn: 想象烟从烟囱冒出，弯向远离房屋的一侧。

abstract.en: Picture a committee that quietly changes its mind after one document is read.
abstract.cn: 想象一个委员会在读完一份文件后悄悄改变了主意。

examples.en: The observer noted a steady wind direction from the south-west.
examples.cn: 观测员记录了稳定的西南风向。

examples.en: A shift in wind direction pushed the fire toward the ridge.
examples.cn: 风向的转变把火推向山脊。

examples.en: The wind rose shows the most common wind direction for each month.
examples.cn: 风玫瑰图显示每个月的常见风向。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「风从哪边来」——风来的那个方位，就是风向

root: 复合短语：wind 来自古英语 wind，属日耳曼语族；direction 经古法语来自拉丁 directio，由 dirigere「摆直、引导」构成，dirigere = dis- + regere「统治、引导」。气象义在 19 世纪成为常规观测项，确切最早书证不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: the source side of the moving air is measured on a compass, reported, read from instruments, followed by pollution, used by aircraft and ships, compared between heights and finally borrowed for public opinion.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线索展开：流动空气的来源方位先被装进罗盘、写进报告、由仪器读出，再被污染物跟随、被飞机与船只使用、在不同高度比较，最后被借去指舆论。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a windsock standing straight out, pointing back to where the air came from.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只风向袋笔直伸出，指回空气的来源。

branches.en: SOURCE AND SCALE: the source side is fixed, then fitted to the compass.
branches.cn: 来源与刻度：先定来向，再装进罗盘。

branches.en: OBSERVATION: a report slot and an instrument reading both carry the same name.
branches.cn: 观测：报告栏目与仪器读数都沿用同一名称。

branches.en: FOLLOW THE PLUME: pollution work asks only where the air will carry things.
branches.cn: 跟随羽流：污染工作只问空气会把东西带到哪里。

branches.en: OPERATIONS AND SHEAR: runways use one bearing, pilots compare two.
branches.cn: 作业与切变：跑道用一个方位，飞行员比较两个高度。

branches.en: POLITICAL WEATHER: opinion acquires a direction and people watch it turn.
branches.cn: 政治天气：舆论有了方向，人们观察它转向。

intro.en: The phrase joins wind with direction, and direction brings a whole Latin family: direct, director, directly and directional.
intro.cn: 这个短语把 wind 与 direction 连接起来，而 direction 带来整个拉丁词族：direct、director、directly、directional。

latinIntro.en: Latin regere 'to guide' and its compound dirigere 'to set straight' give directio, the source of direction; the family is regular and well recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 regere「引导」及其复合词 dirigere「摆直」给出 directio，即 direction 的来源；这个词族规则且记载完整。

items.example: The wind came off the sea.

items.structure: directio (Latin action noun) via Old French
items.meaning: the line along which something points or moves
items.meaningCN: 某物所指或所沿的路线
items.example: The arrow shows the direction of flow.
The sign directs visitors to the gate.

items.meaning: a person who guides an organization
items.example: The director approved the new route.

items.meaning: an instrument that shows wind direction
items.example: The brass wind vane creaked on the roof.
items.exampleCN: 屋顶上的铜风向标吱呀作响。

items.meaning: a fabric cone that shows wind direction and strength
items.meaningCN: 显示风向与风力的布制圆锥袋
items.example: The windsock hung limp in the calm.

definition_zh: 设想；预见；正视
definition_en: to imagine or expect a future situation, and to plan with it in mind
core_image: 会议桌尽头的人把明年的排产表在脑中提前摊开，像把一条还没修的路先走了一遍
scene: 校方设想明年扩招。 We envisage a modest rise in places.
sceneCN: 这里 envisage 是「设想；预见」（第 1 个义项：在脑中提前看到尚未发生的情形）；句意：我们预计名额小幅增加。

pos.zh: 设想；预见；正视

senses.title: To see ahead in the mind
senses.definition: to form a picture of a future state of affairs before it happens
senses.definitionCN: 在事情发生之前先在头脑中形成其图景
senses.example: Designers envisage a quieter campus.
senses.exampleCN: 设计者设想出一个更安静的校园。
senses.why: The prefix en- puts the eye on the thing, and vision supplies the seeing.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 en- 把目光投向对象，vision 提供看的动作。

senses.title: To plan on the assumption
senses.definition: to include a future condition in an arrangement or schedule
senses.definitionCN: 把未来的条件计入某项安排或计划之中
senses.example: The timetable envisages two evening runs.
senses.exampleCN: 时刻表预计加开两班夜车。
senses.why: Official prose moved from imagining to budgeting, so the verb now governs plans.
senses.whyCN: 公文用法从想象走向预算，动词因此管起计划来。

senses.title: To face a difficulty squarely
senses.definition: to confront an unpleasant problem rather than turn from it
senses.definitionCN: 直面令人不快的难题而不回避
senses.example: The report envisages a funding gap.
senses.exampleCN: 报告正视资金缺口问题。
senses.why: The older sense was literally to look something in the face, and the image survives here.
senses.whyCN: 古义本就是直视对方脸庞，这一意象在此保留下来。

intro.en: Envisage joins en- to vis, the seeing stem, with a verbal ending supplied through French.
intro.cn: envisage 把 en- 与表看的词干 vis 结合，动词词尾经由法语补足。

items.en: Videre means to see.
items.cn: videre 意为看。

items.en: Visus gives the noun of sight.
items.cn: visus 派生出视觉的名词。

items.en: Envis means the face or the sight of a thing.
items.cn: envis 指脸庞或某物映入眼帘之态。

items.en: Envisager means to confront with the eyes.
items.cn: envisager 意为用双眼面对。

items.en: English borrows envisage with the literal sense of facing.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语借入 envisage，本义为直面。

items.en: Business and official writing shift the verb toward expectation.
items.cn: 十九世纪商务与公文用法把词义推向预期。

note.en: Group one holds the vis family and the English twin; group two holds other verbs of foreseeing.
note.cn: 第一组是 vis 词族与英语同源孪生词；第二组是其他表预见的动词。

entries.definition: The preferred verb in American writing for the same act.
entries.definitionCN: 美式写作中同一动作的首选动词。

entries.definition: Sight itself, or the foresight credited to a leader.
entries.definitionCN: 指视力，或称赞领导者具有的远见。

entries.definition: Able to be seen, from the identical Latin root.
entries.definitionCN: 可见的，出自同一拉丁词根。

entries.definition: The act of envisaging, mostly found in older prose.
entries.definitionCN: 设想之举，多见于早期文体。

entries.definition: To expect and prepare for what is coming.
entries.definitionCN: 预先期待并为之准备。

entries.definition: The ordinary verb for knowing beforehand.
entries.definitionCN: 事先知道的日常动词。

entries.definition: To form an image of something in the mind.
entries.definitionCN: 在脑中形成某物的画面。

entries.definition: To consider a possibility steadily, often as an option.
entries.definitionCN: 持续考量某种可能，多作为备选。

normalIntro.en: Envisage is the British formal habit; envision is the everyday American choice.
normalIntro.cn: envisage 是英式正式用法，envision 是美式日常选择。

normal.en: Follow it with a noun clause or a gerund, not an infinitive.
normal.cn: 后接名词从句或动名词，不接不定式。

normal.en: Its object is a situation, plan or outcome, not a person.
normal.cn: 宾语是局面、计划或结果，而不是人。

normal.en: Passive forms are common: the scheme was envisaged by the board.
normal.cn: 被动式常见：该方案由董事会设想。

normal.en: Pair with adverbs like realistically, originally, ambitiously.
normal.cn: 常与 realistically、originally、ambitiously 等副词连用。

normal.en: In American prose, swap it for envision without loss of sense.
normal.cn: 在美式文章中可无损地换成 envision。

abstract.en: Picture a surveyor walking a road that is not yet paved.
abstract.cn: 想象测量员走过一条尚未铺装的路。

abstract.en: Imagine turning a stalled car problem to face you and looking it in the eye.
abstract.cn: 想象把棘手的故障转到面前，与它对视。

abstract.en: Think of a budget drawn before the money arrives.
abstract.cn: 想想钱还没到账就先画好的预算表。

examples.en: Planners envisage the line opening within three years.
examples.cn: 规划者设想该线路三年以内通车。

examples.en: No one envisaged a shutdown lasting that long.
examples.cn: 没有人预想到停运会持续这么久。

examples.en: The clause was drafted as ministers originally envisage it.
examples.cn: 该条款按部长们最初的设想起草。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因未视」——因为还没亲眼看见，只能先在脑中看一遍，所以 envisage 是设想、预见；这只是拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）＋ videre（看）→ vis（所见）→ 古法语 envis（脸庞、映入眼帘）＋ 动词后缀 -age → 英语 envisage，核心义「把目光提前投向尚未发生之事」。

sensesIntro.en: The verb runs from mental preview, through planning language, to the older demand that one face a problem.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从脑内预演，经过计划用语，再到要求直面难题的古义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the eye sent forward onto a scene that has not yet arrived.
core.cn: 核心意象：把目光提前投到尚未到场的画面上。

branches.en: The mind supplies the picture before the event.
branches.cn: 事件之前由头脑提供画面。

branches.en: Institutions write that picture into schedules.
branches.cn: 机构把这幅画面写进日程。

branches.en: Turning toward a problem is itself an act of seeing.
branches.cn: 转向难题本身就是一种看见。

branches.en: Both treat the future as something already visible.
branches.cn: 两者都把未来当作已经可见之物。

branches.en: Both belong to formal decision-making prose.
branches.cn: 两者都属于正式的决策文体。

intro.en: A prefix of direction meets a stem of sight and takes a French verbal ending.
intro.cn: 表方向的前缀遇上表视觉的词干，再带上法语的动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre is to see, visus is sight, and provisus is foreseen.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 表看，visus 表视觉，provisus 表已被预见。

items.exampleCN: 建立在 vision 上的姊妹词。

items.example: Re- repeats the same seeing stem.
items.exampleCN: re- 重复同一表看词干。
super- 在上层加上观看者。

core_image: 手指沿着头骨画出一个圆顶
scene: 医生仔细检查了他的头骨。 The doctor examined the cranial bones.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：cranial 指颅骨的；句意是医生检查了他的头骨。

pos.zh: 颅骨的；头盖骨的

senses.title: Of the skull
senses.definition: relating to the bones that enclose the brain
senses.definitionCN: 与包住大脑的骨骼有关
senses.example: He suffered a cranial injury.

senses.why: A dome of bone over the brain.

senses.why: Wires leaving a round room.

senses.title: At the head end
senses.definition: at the head end of a body in biology
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中指身体头端
senses.example: Fish show cranial features near the mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 鱼类在口部附近表现出头端特征。
senses.why: A prow shaped like a head.
senses.whyCN: 船头如头的形状。

intro.en: Cranial comes from Medieval Latin cranium, from Greek kranion, the skull.

items.en: English cranium named the skull.

items.en: Cranial meant of the skull.

items.en: Cranial named skull-side structures.

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cran- stem; the near-meaning group names head and brain anatomy.

definition_zh: 生态系统恢复；协助退化或受损生态系统回到可自我维持状态的过程
definition_en: the process of assisting a degraded or damaged ecosystem to recover its structure, species and self-sustaining processes
core_image: 一片曾经被砍光的坡地先被围起来，再补种本地树苗，几年后溪水的颜色从褐变清
scene: 伐木停止后，山坡先封育三年，再按原来的树种补种，溪水慢慢变清。 The park began ecosystem restoration once the logging licence expired.
sceneCN: 这里指协助受损生态系统恢复结构与功能的过程（第 1 个义项：协助退化生态系统恢复）；句意为伐木许可到期后，公园开始了生态系统恢复工作。

pos.zh: 生态系统恢复（不可数短语名词）
生态系统恢复项目（可数用法，指一项具体工程）

derivatives.zh: 该短语的核心动词，由拉丁语表示「重新建立」的词而来，义为「恢复；修复」
由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「恢复；修复」
由该名词的词干加形容词词尾构成，义为「有恢复作用的」
由该名词与「生态学」组合而成，义为「恢复生态学」，指研究恢复的学科
相邻术语，指使受损系统恢复部分功能而非完整结构，义为「修复；复健」
相邻术语，指清除污染物而非重建群落，义为「治理；修复污染」

senses.title: Assisting a degraded system to recover
senses.definition: the deliberate process of helping a damaged ecosystem regain its structure, species and processes
senses.definitionCN: 有意帮助受损生态系统重新获得结构、物种与运转过程的过程
senses.example: Ecosystem restoration began with fencing the gully and stopping the grazing.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统恢复从围住冲沟、停止放牧开始。
senses.why: The noun is from a verb meaning to rebuild, so the phrase presents recovery as work done rather than waiting.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词出自意为「重新建立」的动词，因此短语把恢复呈现为做出来的工作，而不是等待。

senses.title: Active intervention rather than neglect
senses.definition: intervention such as removing a stressor, reintroducing species or reshaping the ground
senses.definitionCN: 移除胁迫因素、重新引入物种或重塑地面等干预措施
senses.example: Every ecosystem restoration site here needed weed control in the first two years.
senses.exampleCN: 这里每一个生态系统恢复点，头两年都需要控制杂草。
senses.why: Passive recovery happens on its own; restoration adds hands, and the phrase marks that addition.
senses.whyCN: 被动恢复会自行发生，恢复则加上了人的手，这个短语标记的正是这份添加。

senses.title: A reference state to aim at
senses.definition: a described target condition, often drawn from a nearby intact site or from historical records
senses.definitionCN: 被描述的目标状态，通常取自附近未受损的地点或历史记录
senses.example: The plan named a nearby intact fen as the reference for ecosystem restoration.
senses.exampleCN: 方案把附近一片未受损的沼泽定为生态系统恢复的参照。
senses.why: A target has to be specific or the work cannot be judged, so restoration always borrows a picture from somewhere intact.
senses.whyCN: 目标必须具体，否则无法评判工作，因此恢复总要从未受损之处借来一幅图。

senses.title: A branch of applied ecology
senses.titleCN: 应用生态学的一个分支
senses.definition: the science that tests methods for recovery and measures their outcomes
senses.definitionCN: 检验恢复方法并测量其成效的学科
senses.example: Students of ecosystem restoration compare seeded and naturally regenerated plots.
senses.exampleCN: 学习生态系统恢复的学生比较播种地块与自然更新地块。
senses.why: Practice needs a discipline, so the phrase also names the applied science that tests whether recovery methods work.
senses.whyCN: 实践需要学科支撑，因此这个短语也命名检验恢复方法是否有效的应用科学。

senses.title: A policy commitment and programme
senses.definition: a government or international programme with targets, funding and reporting
senses.definitionCN: 带有目标、资金与报告要求的政府或国际计划
senses.example: The national ecosystem restoration targets cover a quarter of the degraded catchment.
senses.exampleCN: 国家的生态系统恢复目标覆盖了这个退化流域的四分之一。
senses.why: Money and targets turn a method into a programme, and the phrase follows the work into public budgets.
senses.whyCN: 资金与目标把方法变成计划，这个短语也随之进入公共预算。

senses.title: Distinct from rehabilitation and remediation
senses.titleCN: 区别于修复与污染治理
senses.definition: a fuller aim than repairing function or cleaning a pollutant, because structure and species are also rebuilt
senses.definitionCN: 比修复功能或清除污染物更完整的目标，因为结构与物种也要重建
senses.example: Cleaning the soil was remediation; rebuilding the floodplain was ecosystem restoration.
senses.exampleCN: 清理土壤属于污染治理，重建漫滩才属于生态系统恢复。
senses.why: Neighbouring words clean or patch, and the phrase is reserved for work that rebuilds structure and species as well.
senses.whyCN: 相邻的词只做清洁或修补，这个短语留给同时重建结构与物种的工作。

senses.title: Measurable outcomes
senses.definition: results reported as returning species, restored flows, soil carbon or reduced erosion
senses.definitionCN: 以回归的物种、恢复的水流、土壤碳或减少的侵蚀报告出来的结果
senses.example: After six years the ecosystem restoration had brought back three lost plant species.
senses.exampleCN: 六年后，这项生态系统恢复带回了三种消失的植物。
senses.why: A restoration that cannot show returns is indistinguishable from gardening, so results became part of the term.
senses.whyCN: 看不出回报的恢复与园艺没有区别，因此成效成了这个术语的一部分。

senses.title: Community involvement and long-term care
senses.definition: work shared with local users and continued through monitoring and maintenance
senses.definitionCN: 与当地使用者共同承担、并通过监测与维护延续的工作
senses.example: Villagers joined the ecosystem restoration because the spring they used had dried.
senses.exampleCN: 村民加入了这项生态系统恢复，因为他们用的那眼泉已经干了。
senses.why: Recovery needs labour for years, and the phrase covers the people who supply it as well as the ecology it aims at.
senses.whyCN: 恢复需要多年的劳力，这个短语既覆盖它瞄准的生态，也覆盖提供劳力的人。

senses.title: A long horizon
senses.definition: an effort measured in decades, since rebuilt systems need time to assemble themselves
senses.definitionCN: 以数十年计的工作，因为重建的系统需要时间自行组合
senses.example: The ecosystem restoration will not be judged for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 这项生态系统恢复在二十年内都不会被下最终结论。
senses.why: Rebuilt systems assemble slowly, so the honest unit of judgement is a decade rather than a season.
senses.whyCN: 重建的系统组合得慢，因此诚实的评判单位是十年，而不是一个季节。

intro.en: The phrase pairs a term coined in nineteen thirty-five from two Greek words with a Latin-derived noun for rebuilding, carried into English through French.
intro.cn: 这个短语用一九三五年由两个希腊词造出的术语，配上一个源自拉丁语、经法语进入英语的「重建」名词。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, and it supplied the idea of the whole place where life is carried on.
items.cn: 这个词意为房屋或家户，提供了「生命在其中展开的整个场所」这一想法。

items.en: Systema meant an organized whole of parts, and it named the unit built from organisms and setting.
items.cn: 这个词意为由部分组成的有机整体，命名了由生物与环境构成的单位。

items.en: Tansley coined ecosystem to treat organisms and their physical surroundings as one working unit.
items.cn: 坦斯利造出表示「生态系统」的新词，把生物与其物理环境视为一个运转的单位。

items.en: The verb meant to rebuild or renew, built from the prefix for again and a stem for standing.
items.cn: 这个动词意为重建、更新，由表示「再次」的前缀与表示「站立」的词干构成。

items.en: French carried the noun into English, where it first meant rebuilding a building or a monarchy.
items.cn: 法语把这个名词带入英语，最初指重建建筑或王权。

items.en: Ecologists adopted the noun for the rebuilding of living systems, and the phrase became standard in the nineteen eighties; its exact first use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 生态学家把这个名词用于重建生命系统，这个短语在二十世纪八十年代成为标准说法；确切首见年代只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares ecosystem or restore; the second group names the neighbouring practices that stop short of full recovery.
note.cn: 第一组共用 ecosystem 或 restore；第二组是停在完整恢复之前的相邻做法。

entries.definition: The act of bringing something back to a former condition.
entries.definitionCN: 指把事物恢复到从前状态的行为。

entries.definition: The verb behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: Having the power to restore strength or condition.
entries.definitionCN: 指具有恢复体力或状态作用的。

entries.definition: The unit being restored.
entries.definitionCN: 指被恢复的那个单位。

entries.definition: A place where food restores you; it shares the same Latin verb but a different trade.
entries.definitionCN: 指供人进食恢复精力的地方；共用同一个拉丁动词，但属另一行业。

entries.definition: Bringing a damaged system back to partial function without rebuilding full structure.
entries.definitionCN: 指使受损系统恢复部分功能，但不重建完整结构。

entries.definition: Removing or neutralising a pollutant from soil or water.
entries.definitionCN: 指从土壤或水体中清除或中和污染物。

entries.definition: Converting damaged land to a new declared use, often not the original one.
entries.definitionCN: 指把受损土地改为新的申报用途，往往不是原来的用途。

entries.definition: Restoring wild processes with minimal ongoing human management.
entries.definitionCN: 指以尽量少的人为持续管理恢复野性过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the coined unit, the rebuilding verb and the four neighbouring practices.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用新造的单位、表示重建的动词，以及四种相邻做法。

normal.en: Ecosystem is a household of parts, and restoration means rebuilding, so the phrase is rebuilding a household of parts.
normal.cn: 前半是部件组成的家，后半是重建，所以这个短语就是重建一个部件之家。

normal.en: Restore, restoration and restorative share one Latin verb for renewing.
normal.cn: 「恢复」「恢复」与「有恢复作用的」共用一个表示更新的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Remediation cleans, rehabilitation repairs function, restoration rebuilds structure and species.
normal.cn: 污染治理做清洁，修复修功能，恢复重建结构与物种。

normal.en: The reference site is the picture of what the work is aiming at.
normal.cn: 参照地点就是这项工作所想达到的那幅画。

normal.en: Decades are the normal unit, because a rebuilt system has to assemble itself.
normal.cn: 数十年是常规单位，因为重建的系统必须自行组合。

abstract.en: Restoration is not a return to a past state but the construction of a system that can continue without us.
abstract.cn: 恢复不是回到某个过去的状态，而是造出一个能离开我们继续运转的系统。

abstract.en: A reference site is a memory made visible, and every restoration is an argument about which memory to trust.
abstract.cn: 参照地点是被看见的记忆，每一次恢复都是关于该信哪段记忆的争论。

abstract.en: The work succeeds when the workers become unnecessary, which is a strange kind of success.
abstract.cn: 当工作者变得多余时，这项工作才算成功，这是一种奇怪的成功。

examples.en: Ecosystem restoration on the floodplain reduced erosion within four years.
examples.cn: 漫滩上的生态系统恢复在四年内减少了侵蚀。

examples.en: The fund pays for ecosystem restoration in the upper catchment.
examples.cn: 这笔基金为上游流域的生态系统恢复出资。

examples.en: Students compared two methods of ecosystem restoration on the same slope.
examples.cn: 学生们在同一片坡地上比较了两种生态系统恢复方法。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「伊扣西斯特姆 瑞斯托瑞申」——前面是生态系统，后面是重新立起来，把塌掉的系统重新立起来

root: 希腊语 oikos「家宅」+ 希腊语 systema「有机整体」→ 表示「生态系统」的新词，一九三五年由坦斯利造出；拉丁语 restaurare「重建、更新」← re-「再次」+ 词干「站立」→ 经法语 restoratio 进入英语为表示「恢复」的名词。两词在二十世纪后期合为生态学术语，确切首见年代只能给约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses separate the aim from the means: recovery as work, intervention, a reference state, a science, a programme, the neighbouring practices, results, people and time.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把目标与手段分开：作为工作的恢复、干预、参照状态、学科、计划、相邻做法、成效、人与时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a logged slope fenced off, replanted with local trees, its stream running clear again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片被砍过的山坡被围起来，补种本地树苗，溪水重新变清。

branches.en: THE AIM AND THE MEANS: helping recovery, and the intervention that distinguishes it from neglect.
branches.cn: 目标与手段：协助恢复，以及使它区别于放任的干预。

branches.en: THE PICTURE: a reference site that says what recovery should look like.
branches.cn: 图景：一个说明恢复应长什么样的参照地点。

branches.en: THE INSTITUTION: a science with methods, and a programme with targets and money.
branches.cn: 制度：有方法的学科，以及有目标与资金的计划。

branches.en: THE BOUNDARY: narrower practices that clean or repair without rebuilding.
branches.cn: 边界：只做清洁或修复、不重建的较窄做法。

branches.en: THE EVIDENCE AND THE PEOPLE: measured returns, shared long-term care, and a horizon in decades.
branches.cn: 证据与人：可测的回归、共同承担的长期维护，以及以数十年计的视野。

intro.en: A Greek house and whole make the unit; a Latin again and standing stem make the rebuilding.
intro.cn: 希腊语的「家宅」与「整体」构成单位，拉丁语的「再次」与「站立」词干构成重建。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies restaurare and its noun restoratio, both recorded; the deeper standing stem is a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「重建」动词与其名词，两者皆有记录；更早的「站立」词干属重构形式。

items.example: It marks the whole place where life is carried on.
items.exampleCN: 它标记生命在其中展开的整个场所。

items.example: It marks the unit as a working whole.
items.exampleCN: 它标记这个单位是运转的整体。

items.example: It marks doing the work a second time.
items.exampleCN: 它标记把这件事再做一遍。

items.example: It supplies the image of something set upright again.
items.exampleCN: 它提供「重新立起来」的形象。

items.example: It is the recorded direct source.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的直接来源。

items.example: It makes the noun for the work.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示这项工作的名词。

items.example: It makes the adjective for what restores.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「有恢复作用」的形容词。

items.example: It is the recorded Greek source of the first element.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、第一成分的希腊语来源。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语动词经法语进入英语，义为「恢复；修复」
由该动词加动作名词词尾构成，义为「恢复」
由该词干加形容词词尾构成，义为「有恢复作用的」
由该名词与生态学组合而成，义为「恢复生态学」

definition_zh: 关于；就……而言；就……事项（正式，用于限定讨论范围）
definition_en: concerning a particular matter; used to narrow the topic of a statement
core_image: 律师在合同边上画一道线，把讨论限定在其中一条
scene: 律师在合同边上画了一道线，把讨论限定在其中一条。 With respect to clause four, both parties accepted the change.
sceneCN: 这里取「关于、就……事项」（第 3 个义项：法律文本中限定具体条款）；句意为就第四条而言，双方接受了改动。

pos.zh: 介词短语：关于；就……而言（正式）
介词短语：就……事项（法律）

senses.title: The formal sentence-opening topic marker
senses.definition: placed at the start of a formal sentence to name the matter under discussion
senses.definitionCN: 置于正式句子开头，点出所讨论的事项
senses.example: With respect to costs, the committee asked for a new estimate.
senses.exampleCN: 关于费用，委员会要求重新估算。
senses.why: The phrase opens a formal frame: the speaker announces the matter first, then speaks only to that matter.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语打开一个正式框架：先报事项，再只就该项发言。

senses.title: Narrowing the topic mid-argument
senses.definition: used to confine an argument to one part of a larger question
senses.definitionCN: 把论证限制在更大问题中的某一部分
senses.example: The proposal is sound with respect to safety, but not with respect to cost.
senses.exampleCN: 这个提案在安全方面是合理的，但在成本方面不是。
senses.why: Two uses in one sentence show the phrase working as a pair of limits rather than a single subject.
senses.whyCN: 一句中用两次，显示这个短语成对地划界，而非只点一个主题。

senses.title: A specific item in legal drafting
senses.definition: in legal texts, used to name the exact item a provision governs
senses.definitionCN: 在法律文本中，点出某条规定所管辖的确切事项
senses.example: With respect to clause four, both parties accepted the change.
senses.exampleCN: 就第四条而言，双方接受了改动。
senses.why: Legal drafting must attach a rule to a precise item, and the phrase supplies that attachment.
senses.whyCN: 法律起草必须把规则挂到确切事项上，这个短语提供这种挂接。

senses.title: Reference to an incoming letter
senses.definition: used in correspondence to name the matter that a reply concerns
senses.definitionCN: 在往来公文中点出答复所涉及的事项
senses.example: With respect to your inquiry, the file has been forwarded.
senses.exampleCN: 关于你的询问，档案已经转出。
senses.why: Correspondence uses the phrase to quote the subject without repeating the whole letter.
senses.whyCN: 公文借此点明主题，不必重复整封来信。

senses.title: The neutral comparative aspect
senses.definition: used to compare two things on one named aspect without ranking them overall
senses.definitionCN: 只就某一指名的方面比较两物，不作总体排序
senses.example: The two models are equal with respect to durability.
senses.exampleCN: 这两款在耐用性方面相同。
senses.why: The phrase can make a comparison narrower and fairer, since it refuses to generalize beyond the named aspect.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语可让比较更窄也更公平，因为它拒绝越过指名方面去概括。

senses.title: The fixed formula of official prose
senses.definition: in official and academic prose it frames a statement in a fixed, somewhat heavy way
senses.definitionCN: 在官方与学术文字中，以固定而略嫌厚重的框架陈述
senses.example: With respect to the second question, no decision has been taken.
senses.exampleCN: 关于第二个问题，尚未作出决定。
senses.why: The formula is chosen for distance and precision; it signals that the writer is answering a listed item.
senses.whyCN: 这一套语用于制造距离与精确，示意作者正在回答清单上的某一项。

senses.title: The boundary against a phrase about scales
senses.titleCN: 与「用什么尺度」类短语的边界
senses.definition: unlike a measure phrase, it asks which matter is meant rather than on what scale it is judged
senses.definitionCN: 与表尺度的短语不同，它问的是哪个事项，而非用什么尺度评判
senses.example: With respect to risk, the question is what counts as a loss.
senses.exampleCN: 就风险而言，问题在于什么算作损失。
senses.why: The split matters in argument: naming a matter invites definition, naming a scale invites measurement.
senses.whyCN: 这一分工在论证中很重要：点事项就要定义，点尺度就要测量。

senses.title: The British legal parallel
senses.definition: in British legal writing the shorter parallel phrase is often preferred in the same slot
senses.definitionCN: 在英式法律文字中，同一位置常用更短的平行说法
senses.example: With respect to the lease, the tenant accepted the terms.
senses.exampleCN: 就该租约而言，承租人接受了条款。
senses.why: Both forms occupy the same formal slot; the choice between them is a matter of house style.
senses.whyCN: 两种形式占同一正式位置，选用哪一种属行文习惯。

intro.en: Respect comes from Latin respectus, a looking back, from respicere, re-, back, plus specere, to look. The Latin line is clear; the prepositional phrase is modern.
intro.cn: respect 来自拉丁语 respectus「回望」，词根 respicere 由 re-「回」与 specere「看」构成。拉丁语线索清楚，介词短语属近代。

items.en: Specere, to look, is also the root of spectacle and specimen.
items.cn: specere 意为「看」，也是 spectacle 与 specimen 的词根。

items.en: Respicere meant to look back at or take notice of, hence to regard.
items.cn: respicere 意为回看、注意，由此引申为顾及。

items.en: The noun named a looking back and later a regard for someone or something.
items.cn: 这个名词本指回望，后来指对某人某物的顾及。

items.en: English respect appears in the Middle English period; the date is approximate.
items.cn: 英语 respect 见于中古英语，年代为约数。

items.en: The phrase with this preposition and to settles in modern official and legal writing.
items.cn: 带这个介词与 to 的短语在近代官方与法律文字中定型。

note.en: The first group also confines a statement but differs in register or in what it points to; the second group holds formal ways of naming a matter.
note.cn: 第一组同样限定陈述，但语域或指向不同；第二组是点明事项的正式说法。

entries.definition: A shorter British legal phrase with the same confining work.
entries.definitionCN: 更短的英式法律短语，限定作用相同。

entries.definition: It names the measure, while this phrase names the matter.
entries.definitionCN: 它点出尺度，而本短语点出事项。

entries.definition: It links two matters without the legal weight.
entries.definitionCN: 连接两件事，没有法律分量。

entries.definition: It shifts topic in speech and sounds much lighter.
entries.definitionCN: 在口语中转移话题，语气轻得多。

entries.definition: It means about and carries no legal tone.
entries.definitionCN: 意为关于，不带法律语气。

entries.definition: A neutral formal equivalent used in letters.
entries.definitionCN: 书信中中性的正式对应词。

entries.definition: It spells out that a topic is being introduced.
entries.definitionCN: 明说正在引入一个话题。

entries.definition: A heavier legal formula for the same limiting move.
entries.definitionCN: 同一限定动作的更厚重法律套语。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real looking-back root, the real legal slot and the real register.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想用真实「回望」词根、真实法律位置与真实语域。

normal.en: Respect is a looking back, so the phrase turns attention onto one named matter.
normal.cn: 词根意为回望，这个短语把注意力转向某个指名事项。

normal.en: It takes a noun, never a clause.
normal.cn: 它接名词，从不接从句。

normal.en: Its British legal twin is shorter and sits in the same slot.
normal.cn: 它的英式法律双胞胎更短，占同一位置。

normal.en: It names the matter, not the scale, which is the boundary against measure phrases.
normal.cn: 它点事项而非尺度，这就是与表尺度短语的边界。

normal.en: Official prose uses it to answer a listed item precisely.
normal.cn: 公文用它精确回答清单上的某一项。

abstract.en: Like a pencil line drawn under one clause of a long contract.
abstract.cn: 像在长合同某一条下面画的一道铅笔线。

abstract.en: Like a lamp turned to one corner of a room instead of the whole room.
abstract.cn: 像把灯转向屋子的一个角落，而非整间屋子。

abstract.en: Like a meeting agenda where only one listed item is opened.
abstract.cn: 像会议议程上只翻开其中一项。

examples.en: With respect to costs, no decision has yet been made.
examples.cn: 关于费用，尚未作出决定。

examples.en: The two designs are equal with respect to safety.
examples.cn: 这两个设计在安全方面相同。

examples.en: With respect to your letter, the documents are enclosed.
examples.cn: 关于你的来信，文件已随函附上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「威斯 瑞斯佩克特 图」——在合同某一条下画一道线：关于、就……而言

root: respect 来自拉丁语 respectus「回望」，词根 respicere 由 re-「回」与 specere「看」构成；短语 with respect to 在近代官方与法律文字中定型，首见年代为约数。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split by what is being confined: a formal opening, a mid-argument limit, a legal item, an incoming letter, a comparative aspect, an official formula, the boundary against measure phrases, and a British parallel.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项按被限定的对象区分：正式开头、论证中的限定、法律事项、来函、比较方面、公文套语、与尺度短语的边界、英式平行说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pencil line drawn under one clause of a contract.
core.cn: 核心意象：在合同某一条下画的一道铅笔线。

branches.en: THE FRAME: formal openings and official formulas announce the matter first.
branches.cn: 框架：正式开头与公文套语先报事项。

branches.en: THE LIMIT: one aspect is isolated for argument or comparison.
branches.cn: 限定：隔离出一个方面用于论证或比较。

branches.en: THE ITEM: legal drafting attaches a rule to an exact clause, in either variant.
branches.cn: 事项：法律起草把规则挂到确切条款，两种变体皆可。

branches.en: THE LETTER: correspondence names the subject being answered.
branches.cn: 来函：公文点出所答复的主题。

branches.en: THE BOUNDARY: matter is named, not scale.
branches.cn: 边界：点事项，不点尺度。

intro.en: The phrase joins a Latin noun of looking back with an English preposition; the look root is the core.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁语「回望」名词与英语介词结合；「看」的词根是核心。

latinIntro.en: The Latin etyma are respicere, to look back, and specere, to look.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语词源是 respicere「回看」与 specere「看」。

items.example: The root runs through the whole spect- family.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根贯穿整个「看」的词族。

items.meaning: to look back at; to regard
items.example: The verb adds direction to the act of looking.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词给「看」加上方向。

items.example: The noun supplies the English base.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供英语基词。

items.example: English keeps both the attention and the esteem senses.
items.exampleCN: 英语保留「注意」与「尊敬」两义。

items.example: The suffix marks the esteem sense.
The adjective keeps the looking-at-each sense.
The adverb distributes items in order.
The phrase is formal and often legal.
items.exampleCN: 这个短语正式，常用于法律。
